affected_predicate.description: Exactly the three latest-followed accounts remain followed and every other listed account is unfollowed.

competing_trace_defects.description: The trajectory begins modifying accounts based on unsupported and changing assumptions about whether list position represents follow recency; the visible list provides no recency metadata.
The agent clicks alex after alex already displays Follow, visibly toggling the account back to Following and undoing prior progress.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 42, the repeated top-row click changes openCompany from Following to Follow even though the stated intent names olivia. Because the UI never identifies which accounts are the latest three, whether that transition harmed the intended membership is unknown. At the last observable step, only openUniversity and frank display Following, so the requirement to retain exactly three accounts is visibly unsatisfied.

summary: The reuse target visibly acts on openCompany rather than its stated olivia target, but the evidence does not identify the intended latest three, so the target's contribution remains unknown. The terminal UI visibly retains only two followed accounts; earlier unsupported recency assumptions and an erroneous re-follow toggle are independent defects.
